fato_historico: 1813: At the Battle of Großbeeren, the Prussians under Von Bülow repulse the French army.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an influx of resilient energy, much like a steady tide shifting the course of events. It is a good time to consider how your sensitivity can be a powerful shield. Just as history teaches us that quiet persistence overcomes great opposition, your compassionate heart may find the strength to navigate any challenge with graceful flow and deep intuition.
frase_do_dia: Gentle waters often carve the deepest paths through the strongest rocks.
significado_numero: Represents a karmic cycle of transformation and necessary inner growth.
conselho: Trust your intuition and stand firm in your gentle, authentic truth today.
